styleLock.backgroundSystem: flat pastel lilac studio backdrops with soft geometric circle and rounded-corner white card motifs; pure white for spec and gallery screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light, front or top-left key, gentle soft shadows and contact shadows, cool clean highlights
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth matte pastel podiums, round cream pedestal, matte grey cube plinth
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; bold short Chinese headlines wrapped in 「」 with a dash-dot divider motif; indigo headings on light backgrounds, white headings on periwinkle banners
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line indigo icons with dash-dot dividers and flowing concentric sound-wave line motifs
styleLock.presentationRules: product always centered and stable, rendered exactly as the reference image, never floating, subtle contact shadow; consistent hero angle across family shots; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent light-tech pastel audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist lavender #E9EBF9, cream beige #F2E3D3, soft periwinkle #8A93D6 and indigo accent #4A5BC0, with pure white #FFFFFF for spec and gallery screens and ink #2B2E4A for body text; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif with bold short Chinese headlines wrapped in 「」 and a dash-dot divider motif; flat pastel backdrops with soft geometric circles and rounded-corner white cards; bright soft diffused studio lighting with gentle soft and contact shadows; thin-line indigo icon style with flowing concentric sound-wave line motifs; product always centered and stable, rendered exactly as the reference image, never floating; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 7 片 800x1200 详情切片（60px 重叠）提炼。已剥离：乱码拼音字样、右下角会员二维码贴片、规格表假数据（如 230V/XX品牌）与全部原标题文案（改由 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽由使用方填写）。品类按图片内容判定：L1 手机数码 / L2 耳机音频，与源文件夹「数码」归类一致，无需纠正；主体为长柄半入耳真无线耳机，以「轻时尚长柄半入耳」定位与库内已有 10 款耳机模版区分。分镜按转化漏斗重排为 6 幕；源图未提供痛点/对比/资质素材，产品实拍区在源图为空置模板块，已提炼为通用实拍合集版式；不发明任何参数、认证与功效承诺，声学与规格均由文案槽承载。
